record.paper_title: Some open problems on Feynman periods
record.original_question: For the wheel graphs W_n with n ≥ 3, is every convergent generalized Feynman period of W_n a rational linear combination of odd Riemann zeta values only, namely an element of Q + Qζ(3) + ··· + Qζ(2n−3)? Equivalently, must all even zeta values, products of zeta values, and higher-depth multiple zeta values be absent from the period space Pc(W_n)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 1. Wheel graphs Wn (n ≥ 3) have only odd Riemann zetas as periods: Pc(Wn) = Q+Qζ (3) +···+Qζ (2n−3). (20)
Notice how far Thm. 3 still is from Eq. (20): We not only have to exclude multiple zeta values, but also all even Riemann zeta values ζ (2k).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 3$ and let $W_n$ denote the wheel graph on $n+1$ vertices, obtained by joining a single hub vertex to every vertex of a cycle of length $n$. To each connected Feynman graph $G$ one associates a (convergent, scheme-independent) period; more generally, by varying the kinematic/regulator setup one obtains a $\mathbb{Q}$-vector space $P_c(G)$ of convergent generalized Feynman periods attached to $G$, spanned by all convergent projective integrals
$$\int_{\sigma}\frac{N(\alpha)\,\Omega}{\Psi_G(\alpha)^{D/2}}$$
arising from $G$ (where $\Psi_G$ is the first Symanzik polynomial of $G$, $\Omega$ is the canonical projective volume form on $\mathbb{P}^{|E(G)|-1}$, $\sigma$ is the positive coordinate simplex, and $N$ ranges over admissible numerators making the integral convergent).

Prove or disprove the following: for every $n\ge 3$,
$$P_c(W_n) \;=\; \mathbb{Q} + \mathbb{Q}\,\zeta(3) + \mathbb{Q}\,\zeta(5) + \cdots + \mathbb{Q}\,\zeta(2n-3),$$
where $\zeta(s)=\sum_{k\ge 1}k^{-s}$ is the Riemann zeta function. Equivalently, show that no even Riemann zeta value $\zeta(2k)$, no product of Riemann zeta values, and no irreducible multiple zeta value of depth $\ge 2$ appears in the period space of any wheel graph $W_n$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture remains open. Recent work (2024) on wheel classes in the locally finite homology of GL_n(ℤ) and canonical/Feynman integrals confirms the appearance of odd zeta values and products thereof in related canonical integrals but does not establish the absence of even zetas, products, or higher-depth MZVs in the full period space of wheel graphs. Surveys on graphical functions and Feynman periods continue to list the odd-zeta-only behavior of wheels as a conjecture.

status_evidence.title: The wheel classes in the locally finite homology of GL_n(ℤ), canonical integrals and zeta values
status_evidence.snippet: Canonical integrals associated to wheel classes evaluate to products of odd zeta values ζ(m)ζ(n); supports conjectures about appearance of odd zetas.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work establishes partial results about odd zeta values appearing in wheel-related integrals, but does not prove the full odd-zeta-only conjecture for P_c(W_n).

status_evidence.title: Feynman integrals, graph polynomials and zeta values (Panzer)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Feynman period computations; wheel graphs are conjectured to evaluate to single odd zeta values.
status_evidence.claim: The odd-zeta conjecture for wheel periods is stated as an open conjecture in surveys on Feynman periods.
